Grace is thirteen years old and lives in a village with her parents and two older brothers. She spends most of her free time outdoors. She loves riding her bicycle along the country roads near her house. She also enjoys gardening with her mother. They grow tomatoes, carrots and lettuce in their garden. Part_Guideline: Read the article. For each question, choose the correct answer (A, B or C).
Passage:
A teenager's experience with plastic waste

Fifteen-year-old Hasan lives in a big city near the coast. Two years ago, he went to the beach with his family and was very sad to see a lot of plastic rubbish on the sand. There were plastic bottles, bags and broken toys everywhere. Some fish near the shore looked sick. Hasan decided that he needed to do something to help.

He started a small group at his school called 'Clean Our Coast'. Every Saturday morning, Hasan and his friends meet at the beach at 8am. They bring large bags and gloves. They walk along the beach for two hours and collect all the plastic they can find. Last month, they collected 15 bags of rubbish in just one morning. Hasan's teacher, Mrs. Khan, was very impressed. She asked Hasan to speak about his project in a school assembly.

Hasan also learned how plastic harms sea animals. Turtles often eat plastic bags because they look like jellyfish. This makes them very sick. Hasan talked to his parents about using fewer plastic bottles at home. Now his family uses reusable water bottles. His mother takes cloth bags to the supermarket instead of using plastic ones.

Hasan's dream is to see a beach with no plastic at all. He knows this will take a long time, but he is not going to stop. He believes that if more young people join him, they can make a big difference. 'Even small actions are important,' he says.
Evidence: Two years ago, he went to the beach with his family and was very sad to see a lot of plastic rubbish on the sand.
Question: Why did Hasan become sad at the beach?
Opt_A: Because the water was too cold
Opt_B: Because he saw a lot of plastic rubbish
Opt_C: Because he lost his phone in the sand
Explanation: Bài đọc nói 'he was very sad to see a lot of plastic rubbish on the sand' (anh ấy rất buồn khi thấy rất nhiều rác nhựa trên cát).

Explanation: Bài đọc viết rõ: 'They walk along the beach for two hours and collect all the plastic they can find' (Họ đi bộ dọc bãi biển trong hai giờ và thu gom tất cả nhựa mà họ có thể tìm thấy).

Part_Guideline: Write an email to your friend. Write 30 words or more.
Passage:
Read this email from your English friend, Ben.
Subject: Let's be more healthy!
Hi,
I want to start doing more exercise.
- What sport or activity should I try?
- Why is this activity good for me? (Please explain the reason)
- Can we do this activity together?
Write back soon.
Ben
Question: Write an email to Ben.
Answer:
Hi Ben,
You should try playing badminton. It is good for your health because it makes your arms and legs stronger, and it is a lot of fun. Yes, we can play together at the sports centre on Saturdays. Let me know!
Mai
Explanation: Bài mẫu trả lời đủ 3 ý của Ben: (1) 'playing badminton' - gợi ý môn thể thao, (2) 'because it makes your arms and legs stronger' - giải thích lý do (tại sao tốt), (3) 'we can play together on Saturdays' - đồng ý làm cùng. Dài 35 từ, đạt yêu cầu 30+ từ.
